godbolt_skip: IDxcCursor/IDxcIntelliSense is a COM/libclang-style AST-walking API, not something Compiler Explorer's compile-and-show-output panes can exercise; there is no compiler-output artifact for a pane to display. Evidence for this issue is the isense_probe.cpp harness driving the API directly (see manual-case-*.txt and variant-*.txt).
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: IDxcCursor/IDxcTranslationUnit exposes no attribute cursor at all for HLSL semantics (struct field, parameter, or return type); confirmed by direct API harness against main-debug (89e2f98e2, unchanged) plus oldest (v1.4.1907) and newest (v1.9.2607) catalogued releases, and by source: semantics are stored via a Decl-level UnusualAnnotation side channel that libclang's VisitAttributes never walks, so a real Attr-based cursor (control: [numthreads]) surfaces but the semantic never does. Maintainer already declined to prioritize in favor of future LSP tooling; patch welcome.
title: IDxcCursor misses semantics
